subjects.source: Authored subject definition; Vaswani et al., Attention Is All You Need (2017)

subjects.name: Model token vector representation
subjects.settles: Specify the vector assigned to a token at a stated model location and version.
subjects.excludes: Treating a vector as a uniquely identified human concept.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; Vaswani et al., Attention Is All You Need (2017)

subjects.name: Model token probability estimation
subjects.settles: Determine the model's probability assignments to candidate output tokens under specified context and parameters.
subjects.excludes: Choosing a token or verifying the truth of the resulting text.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; Vaswani et al., Attention Is All You Need (2017)

subjects.name: Model token output selection
subjects.settles: Choose an output token from a specified model distribution under a stated decoding rule.
subjects.excludes: Estimating the distribution or establishing response quality.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; Vaswani et al., Attention Is All You Need (2017)

subjects.name: Model attention weight computation
subjects.settles: Determine numerical weights from specified query and key representations under a fixed attention rule.
subjects.excludes: Human attention allocation or explanatory importance of a token.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; Vaswani et al., Attention Is All You Need (2017)

subjects.name: Model attention value aggregation
subjects.settles: Determine the representation obtained by combining value vectors with specified attention weights.
subjects.excludes: How the weights were chosen or whether the output is a faithful explanation.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; Vaswani et al., Attention Is All You Need (2017)

subjects.name: Model sequence position representation
subjects.settles: Specify how sequence position is represented for a stated model computation.
subjects.excludes: Temporal order in the represented world or semantic chronology.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; Vaswani et al., Attention Is All You Need (2017)

subjects.name: Model parameter update
subjects.settles: Determine the changed parameter values produced by a stated training step.
subjects.excludes: Experience-dependent change in every kind of learner or general intelligence gain.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; Current user direction and attached expansion note

subjects.name: Measurement target specification
subjects.settles: Specify the quantity intended to be measured, including its object and conditions.
subjects.excludes: Choosing an instrument or establishing that a proxy measures that quantity.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; NIST/SEMATECH, Measurement Process Characterization

subjects.name: Measurement instrument calibration
subjects.settles: Determine the relation between instrument indications and reference values under specified conditions.
subjects.excludes: Removing every source of error or validating the intended construct.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; NIST/SEMATECH, Measurement Process Characterization

subjects.name: Measurement result uncertainty
subjects.settles: Characterize the range or distribution of values attributable to a stated measurement result under explicit assumptions.
subjects.excludes: The actual unknown error or the truth of every claim based on that result.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; NIST/SEMATECH, Uncertainty analysis

subjects.name: Measurement result repeatability
subjects.settles: Determine variation across repeated measurements under stated stable conditions.
subjects.excludes: Agreement across changed instruments, operators, or laboratories.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; NIST/SEMATECH, Uncertainty analysis

subjects.name: Measurement proxy validity
subjects.settles: Determine whether a specified observable supports the intended inference about a target property in a bounded setting.
subjects.excludes: Reliable measurement of the observable itself or general validity for every purpose.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; Current user direction and attached expansion note

subjects.name: Integer factor decomposition
subjects.settles: Determine prime factors and multiplicities whose product equals a specified integer greater than one.
subjects.excludes: The runtime of every factorization method or the primality of an unrelated integer.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; AMS / zbMATH, MSC2020

subjects.name: Integer primality determination
subjects.settles: Determine whether an integer greater than one has a positive divisor other than one and itself.
subjects.excludes: Producing all factors of every composite input.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; AMS / zbMATH, MSC2020

subjects.name: Graph path existence
subjects.settles: Determine whether a path connects specified vertices under a graph's permitted edge directions.
subjects.excludes: The shortest such path or whether a Hamiltonian cycle exists.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; AMS / zbMATH, MSC2020

subjects.name: Graph path minimum cost
subjects.settles: Determine a connecting path with minimum total cost under specified edge costs and admissibility conditions.
subjects.excludes: Existence of a finite minimum when negative cycles or other conditions prevent one.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; AMS / zbMATH, MSC2020

subjects.name: Graph structure equivalence
subjects.settles: Determine whether a bijection between vertex sets preserves the specified adjacency relation.
subjects.excludes: Visual similarity of graph drawings or equality of node labels.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; AMS / zbMATH, MSC2020

subjects.name: Equation solution existence
subjects.settles: Determine whether any admissible assignment satisfies a specified equation system.
subjects.excludes: Finding a solution or proving its uniqueness.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; AMS / zbMATH, MSC2020

subjects.name: Equation solution uniqueness
subjects.settles: Determine whether a specified equation system has exactly one admissible solution.
subjects.excludes: Existence alone or stability under perturbed coefficients.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; AMS / zbMATH, MSC2020

subjects.name: Price demand response
subjects.settles: Determine how demand for a specified good changes with its price under stated conditions.
subjects.excludes: Effects of simultaneous income or quality changes left uncontrolled.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; AEA, JEL Classification System

subjects.name: Exchange allocation feasibility
subjects.settles: Determine whether a proposed allocation meets specified resource and exchange constraints.
subjects.excludes: Whether participants prefer it or have incentives to implement it.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; AEA, JEL Classification System

subjects.name: Exchange allocation incentive compatibility
subjects.settles: Determine whether participants achieve the stated preference objective by prescribed behavior under specified information and rules.
subjects.excludes: Fairness, feasibility, or effectiveness without those assumptions.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; AEA, JEL Classification System

subjects.name: Production input requirement
subjects.settles: Determine the inputs required to produce a specified output by a stated technology.
subjects.excludes: The monetary cost of those inputs or every possible production technology.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; AEA, JEL Classification System

subjects.name: Production cost estimation
subjects.settles: Estimate costs of producing a specified output under stated technology and input prices.
subjects.excludes: Demand for the output or whether the producer should produce it.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; AEA, JEL Classification System

subjects.name: Business customer demand estimation
subjects.settles: Estimate demand from a specified customer population for an identified offering under stated conditions.
subjects.excludes: A recommendation to enter the market or general customer satisfaction.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; US Small Business Administration, Plan your business

subjects.name: Business cash requirement
subjects.settles: Determine the cash needed across a specified operating or startup interval under explicit payment assumptions.
subjects.excludes: Accounting profit or obtaining funding.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; US Small Business Administration, Plan your business

subjects.name: Rule authority basis
subjects.settles: Determine which specified source authorizes an institution to issue or apply an identified rule in a stated jurisdiction.
subjects.excludes: Whether the rule is desirable or achieves its intended outcome.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; Office of the Federal Register, Guide to the Rulemaking Process

subjects.name: Rule scope applicability
subjects.settles: Determine whether identified facts fall within a rule's stated application conditions.
subjects.excludes: The rule's legal validity or justified moral authority.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; Office of the Federal Register, Guide to the Rulemaking Process

subjects.name: Rule content interpretation
subjects.settles: Determine what an identified rule prescribes under a stated interpretive framework.
subjects.excludes: Whether anyone complied with it or whether it should have that content.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; Office of the Federal Register, Guide to the Rulemaking Process

subjects.name: Rule content revision
subjects.settles: Specify a changed rule while preserving the prior version and the scope of the change.
subjects.excludes: Authorization or successful implementation of that revision.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; Office of the Federal Register, Guide to the Rulemaking Process

subjects.name: Rule compliance determination
subjects.settles: Determine whether specified conduct satisfies an applicable rule under an identified interpretation.
subjects.excludes: The justice of the rule or factual truth of unexamined testimony.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; Office of the Federal Register, Guide to the Rulemaking Process

subjects.name: Rule effect attribution
subjects.settles: Determine what difference a rule's introduction or enforcement caused in a specified outcome relative to a defensible comparison.
subjects.excludes: Whether the rule was validly enacted or correlation alone.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; Current user direction and attached expansion note

subjects.name: Rule proposal comment relevance
subjects.settles: Determine which submitted information bears on a specified proposed rule or its supporting rationale.
subjects.excludes: Counting supportive comments or treating popularity as dispositive legal authority.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; Office of the Federal Register, Guide to the Rulemaking Process

subjects.name: Norm justification sufficiency
subjects.settles: Determine whether stated reasons warrant a specified normative conclusion under an explicit justificatory framework.
subjects.excludes: A descriptive claim about popularity or a jurisdiction's enactment procedure.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; PhilPapers categorization project

subjects.name: Object identity persistence
subjects.settles: Determine which stated criteria make an object at one time count as the same object at another.
subjects.excludes: Mere qualitative similarity or an identity criterion for every kind of object.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; PhilPapers categorization project

subjects.name: Experience quality discrimination
subjects.settles: Determine which qualitative differences a subject reports or discriminates between specified experiences.
subjects.excludes: An inference that a particular computational operation produces consciousness.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; PhilPapers categorization project

subjects.name: Narrative event ordering
subjects.settles: Determine the order in which specified events are presented in a narrative.
subjects.excludes: The chronological order of the represented events or their causal dependence.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; Aristotle, Poetics, translated by S. H. Butcher

subjects.name: Narrative event causal coherence
subjects.settles: Determine whether proposed causal links between represented events fit the narrative's stated world conditions.
subjects.excludes: Historical truth of fictional events or merely chronological ordering.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; Aristotle, Poetics, translated by S. H. Butcher

subjects.name: Narrative audience expectation
subjects.settles: Determine what a specified audience anticipates at a given point in a narrative.
subjects.excludes: What actually happens next or what every audience must expect.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; Current user direction and attached expansion note

subjects.name: Narrative audience information access
subjects.settles: Determine which story facts are available to a specified audience at each presentation point.
subjects.excludes: What characters know or which available facts the audience noticed.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; Current user direction and attached expansion note

subjects.name: Narrative audience enjoyment
subjects.settles: Determine the enjoyment a specified audience experiences from a defined narrative exposure under stated conditions.
subjects.excludes: Universal artistic merit or enjoyment from every entertainment form.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; Current user direction and attached expansion note

subjects.name: Resource retention selection
subjects.settles: Choose which identified resources to retain for specified possible future uses under stated constraints.
subjects.excludes: Acquiring resources or assuming retention is always beneficial.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; Current user direction and attached expansion note

subjects.name: Resource retention duration
subjects.settles: Determine how long an identified resource should be retained under specified use and loss conditions.
subjects.excludes: How much storage it occupies or a universal retention schedule.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; Current user direction and attached expansion note

subjects.name: Resource retention cost
subjects.settles: Determine the costs attributable to retaining specified resources over a stated interval.
subjects.excludes: The costs of reacquisition after disposal or total historical acquisition cost.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; Current user direction and attached expansion note

subjects.name: Resource disposal consequence
subjects.settles: Determine which future possibilities are lost or changed by disposing of an identified resource under stated alternatives.
subjects.excludes: Whether disposal should occur under every objective.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; Current user direction and attached expansion note

subjects.name: Resource disposal reversibility
subjects.settles: Determine whether a disposed resource or its required function can be recovered under stated conditions.
subjects.excludes: Whether it is worthwhile to recover it or whether any similar resource exists.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; Current user direction and attached expansion note

subjects.name: Resource future use likelihood
subjects.settles: Estimate the chance that a specified resource will be needed for a defined use within a stated horizon.
subjects.excludes: How valuable that use would be or whether the resource will remain accessible.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; Current user direction and attached expansion note

subjects.name: Resource future use value
subjects.settles: Determine the value of a possible later use of an identified resource under a stated objective.
subjects.excludes: Probability of that use or the costs of storage.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; Current user direction and attached expansion note

subjects.name: Resource retrieval cost
subjects.settles: Determine the cost of locating and accessing an identified retained resource in a specified storage arrangement.
subjects.excludes: Retention cost before retrieval or whether the resource is useful.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; Current user direction and attached expansion note

subjects.name: Subject requirement necessity
subjects.settles: Determine whether a stated condition is necessary for a specified subject operation or justified result under explicit scope.
subjects.excludes: A useful method-specific condition being universally necessary.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; Current user direction and attached expansion note

subjects.name: Subject requirement alternatives
subjects.settles: Determine which alternative condition sets can support the same specified result.
subjects.excludes: A claim that every listed condition must hold together.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; Current user direction and attached expansion note

subjects.name: Subject translation coverage
subjects.settles: Determine which defined matters in a specified source term are preserved by a proposed translation into named subjects.
subjects.excludes: Whether the source term is popular or all its claims are true.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; Current user direction and attached expansion note

subjects.name: Subject translation equivalence
subjects.settles: Determine whether two fixed subject descriptions pick out the same specified matter under stated conditions.
subjects.excludes: Sharing a general operation or being relevant to the same goal.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; Current user direction and attached expansion note

subjects.name: Subject development assessment
subjects.settles: Determine what specified results, techniques, evidence, and remaining limitations have been established within a subject's bounded scope.
subjects.excludes: The subject's popularity or a universal scalar maturity score.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; Current user direction and attached expansion note

subjects.name: Subject importance assessment
subjects.settles: Determine how resolving a specified matter affects stated goals, costs, risks, or further work relative to alternatives.
subjects.excludes: Intrinsic importance independent of beneficiaries or objectives.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; Current user direction and attached expansion note

subjects.name: Subject attention measurement
subjects.settles: Determine how much documented research or practical effort a subject receives within a declared corpus, period, and counting rule.
subjects.excludes: Neglect in the world inferred from an unfamiliar name or this workbook's row count.
subjects.source: Authored subject definition; Current user direction and attached expansion note

subjects.name: Perspective representation construction
subjects.settles: Construct a specified organization of a matter that exposes selected distinctions and operations.
subjects.excludes: Changing only terminology without a consequential representational change.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Perspective representation omission
subjects.settles: Determine which consequential distinctions of the target matter a specified perspective leaves unavailable.
subjects.excludes: Proving the perspective useless for every task.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Perspective representation equivalence
subjects.settles: Determine whether two specified perspectives preserve the same discriminations and licensed transitions on a declared case domain.
subjects.excludes: Literal wording identity or a claim of equivalent implementation cost.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Perspective consequence accessibility
subjects.settles: Determine which consequences an agent can derive using a specified perspective under stated resources.
subjects.excludes: Consequences merely true in the world or present in an inaccessible representation.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Perspective change contribution
subjects.settles: Determine what changing a perspective adds to a specified inquiry or performance with the target and success standard fixed.
subjects.excludes: Improvement produced only by replacing the goal or grading rule.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Perspective change criterion drift
subjects.settles: Determine whether a changed verdict follows from a changed evaluative rule rather than a changed representation of the same matter.
subjects.excludes: Judging the new criterion illegitimate simply because it changed.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Perspective scope applicability
subjects.settles: Determine whether a perspective's required distinctions and assumptions can be instantiated in a specified new matter.
subjects.excludes: Proving explanatory adequacy or equivalent empirical mechanisms.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Perspective scope extension
subjects.settles: Construct a justified application of a perspective to a matter outside its previously recorded use domain.
subjects.excludes: Declaring every subject an instance by redefining the terms after the fact.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Perspective scope coverage
subjects.settles: Determine which matters in a declared domain a perspective can address under a specified adequacy requirement.
subjects.excludes: Worldwide pervasiveness inferred from a few examples.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Perspective scope limitation
subjects.settles: Identify a specified question or distinction the perspective cannot resolve under its stated assumptions.
subjects.excludes: A failure caused only by missing resources outside those assumptions.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Perspective selection
subjects.settles: Choose a perspective for a specified inquiry from stated candidates under a declared selection rule.
subjects.excludes: Constructing a missing perspective or establishing that the selected one is universally best.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Perspective comparison admissibility
subjects.settles: Specify which perspectives are admitted to a comparison and why each belongs to that set.
subjects.excludes: A conclusion quantified over every imaginable preference or goal.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Anticipation outcome expectation
subjects.settles: Determine what an agent expects may occur at a stated later point, including uncertainty when represented.
subjects.excludes: A verbal forecast, a desired outcome, or readiness inferred without evidence.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Anticipation outcome correspondence
subjects.settles: Determine how a recorded or operationally specified earlier expectation relates to the later observed outcome.
subjects.excludes: Independent predictive accuracy when the expectation itself changes the outcome.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Anticipation action dependence
subjects.settles: Determine how expected later consequences differ under specified alternative actions.
subjects.excludes: Selecting an action or treating conditional possibilities as equally believed forecasts.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Anticipation preparation selection
subjects.settles: Choose what to prepare now in view of specified possible later conditions.
subjects.excludes: Accurately forecasting which condition will occur or asserting a future claim.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Anticipation response construction
subjects.settles: Construct a prospective response contribution from the anticipated conversation conditions and unresolved matter.
subjects.excludes: Retrospectively explaining a response already produced.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Anticipation continuation construction
subjects.settles: Construct a possible subsequent exchange by using an anticipated response as input to a further anticipated prompt or response.
subjects.excludes: A single forecast with no continued interaction or fabricated observed dialogue.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Anticipation continuation exclusion
subjects.settles: Construct a continuation that preserves the unresolved matter while excluding a specified anticipated way of proceeding.
subjects.excludes: Irrelevance, random text, or banning the same operation in every later task.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Anticipation influence attribution
subjects.settles: Determine how expressing or using an anticipation changes later activity or outcomes.
subjects.excludes: Treating a deliberately fulfilled anticipation as independent predictive validation.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Anticipation outcome expectation revision
subjects.settles: Change what an agent expects will occur in response to an identified consequential difference.
subjects.excludes: Changing only the preparation while the expectation stays fixed, or erasing the prior expectation.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Anticipation preparation revision
subjects.settles: Change a specified preparation in view of an identified difference in later conditions or available means.
subjects.excludes: Changing only the estimated likelihood without changing the preparation.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Prediction claim expression
subjects.settles: Express a claim about a specified future or unknown outcome with its scope and epistemic force explicit.
subjects.excludes: Having an unexpressed expectation, estimating a hidden current state, or preparing for an outcome.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Model state estimation
subjects.settles: Determine a model's estimate or distribution over an unobserved state from specified observations and assumptions.
subjects.excludes: A claim about a future event or proof that a biological system implements the model.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Uncertainty alternative specification
subjects.settles: Specify the unresolved alternatives for a defined target relative to an information state.
subjects.excludes: Assigning probabilities without a basis or confusing uncertainty with unspecified wording.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Uncertainty source attribution
subjects.settles: Determine which missing observations, ambiguous representations or model assumptions sustain a specified uncertainty.
subjects.excludes: Assuming every uncertainty can be removed by collecting more data.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Uncertainty decision sensitivity
subjects.settles: Determine which unresolved differences would change a specified choice under fixed decision conditions.
subjects.excludes: Requiring every uncertainty to be resolved before acting.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Uncertainty reduction intervention selection
subjects.settles: Choose an observation or transformation expected to distinguish specified live alternatives under stated costs.
subjects.excludes: Seeking information that cannot affect the unresolved matter.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Uncertainty reduction attainability
subjects.settles: Determine whether specified uncertainty can be reduced using the admissible observations or operations.
subjects.excludes: Worldwide unknowability inferred from failure of the current method.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Conflict incompatibility specification
subjects.settles: Specify which identified demands, states or commitments cannot jointly be satisfied under stated constraints.
subjects.excludes: Treating disagreement in language as proof of incompatible outcomes.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Conflict resolution condition
subjects.settles: Specify what change would count as resolving an identified incompatibility.
subjects.excludes: Merely suppressing its expression or assuming one party must lose.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Conflict resolution method selection
subjects.settles: Choose a method for resolving a specified incompatibility under identified constraints.
subjects.excludes: Creating the method or proving that its execution resolved the conflict.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Conflict resolution method creation
subjects.settles: Construct a method for changing the conditions producing a specified incompatibility.
subjects.excludes: Inventing a new method name without executable changes.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Conflict resolution method applicability
subjects.settles: Determine whether a proposed resolution method's operating conditions hold in a specified conflict.
subjects.excludes: Its desirability to every participant or its observed effectiveness.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Conflict resolution effect attribution
subjects.settles: Determine which changes in the incompatibility are attributable to a specified resolution attempt.
subjects.excludes: Success inferred only from agreement with the method's name or from silence.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Deviation reference specification
subjects.settles: Specify the reference state, rule or pattern from which a departure is being considered.
subjects.excludes: Calling the reference desirable or treating customary behavior as obligatory.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Deviation extent determination
subjects.settles: Determine the amount or structure of a departure under a specified difference relation.
subjects.excludes: Its beneficial effect, creativity or unusualness in a population.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Deviation cause attribution
subjects.settles: Determine what produced a specified departure from its reference under stated causal assumptions.
subjects.excludes: Whether the departure was beneficial or intentionally chosen.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Deviation effect comparison
subjects.settles: Determine how a specified departure changes the relevant outcomes under a fixed comparison standard.
subjects.excludes: The distance from the reference or its rarity.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Deviation effect robustness
subjects.settles: Determine whether a departure's comparative effect persists across a declared set of conditions or evaluative perspectives.
subjects.excludes: Benefit for an unrestricted set of all conceivable goals.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Deviation optimality condition derivation
subjects.settles: Derive conditions under which a departure attains the best permitted result in a specified formal model.
subjects.excludes: Evidence that an actual agent attained that result or that the model covers reality completely.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Deviation optimality case determination
subjects.settles: Determine whether a particular departure attains the specified optimum under the actual case's admitted alternatives and evidence.
subjects.excludes: Optimality in a model whose relevant assumptions fail in the case.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Deviation optimality attainability
subjects.settles: Determine whether any feasible departure attains the stipulated optimum or all required criteria jointly.
subjects.excludes: Assuming a supremum is attained or incomparable objectives share one best item.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Comparison alternative dominance
subjects.settles: Determine whether one alternative is no worse on every specified criterion and better on at least one.
subjects.excludes: A weighted average concealing a loss or superiority under every possible criterion.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Comparison alternative robust dominance
subjects.settles: Determine whether a dominance relation holds under every admitted scenario with its strictness rule stated.
subjects.excludes: Dominance established only after averaging scenarios or changing criteria.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Resource use avoidable cost
subjects.settles: Determine the excess resources consumed relative to an available feasible alternative meeting the same specified result standard.
subjects.excludes: Declaring creative exploration wasteful solely because a cheaper familiar answer existed.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Game payoff sum invariance
subjects.settles: Determine whether the sum of specified participant payoffs is constant across all admitted outcomes under a fixed payoff representation.
subjects.excludes: A single tradeoff between two choices or an invariant sum under arbitrarily changed scales.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Subject name scope underdetermination
subjects.settles: Determine which consequential parts of a subject's scope its name and available definition leave unspecified.
subjects.excludes: Multiple fully specified meanings, which are recorded as ambiguity instead.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Subject name origin reconstruction
subjects.settles: Reconstruct how a specified subject label acquired its recorded wording and referent from available historical evidence.
subjects.excludes: Inventing a psychological motive for the name's author.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Subject name persistence cause
subjects.settles: Determine what sustains a subject label's continued use despite identified scope defects.
subjects.excludes: Assuming familiarity, authority or convenience is the cause without evidence.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Subject name substitution effect
subjects.settles: Determine how replacing a subject label changes the inferences, questions or operations people actually perform with fixed underlying content.
subjects.excludes: An asserted improvement based only on liking the new wording.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Expression precision requirement
subjects.settles: Specify which distinctions an expression must preserve for a particular use to be adequate.
subjects.excludes: Demanding maximal detail in every context or confusing brevity with imprecision.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Explanation account operational content
subjects.settles: Identify the specified variables, relations or transformations by which an account explains its target and the choices it leaves unspecified.
subjects.excludes: Treating the title of a theory as its mechanism or requiring every explanation to be a software procedure.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Memory active content interference
subjects.settles: Determine how specified competing material changes the usability of active task content.
subjects.excludes: Interference only during retrieval of long-term records.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Memory active content interference control
subjects.settles: Determine which operations preserve active task content against specified competing material and under what conditions.
subjects.excludes: The occurrence of interference or a claim that a named circuit necessarily implements control.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Memory active content binding
subjects.settles: Determine how elements of active task content are associated into a usable structure under stated conditions.
subjects.excludes: Permanent associations in storage or a universal requirement that every active representation is bound this way.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Memory active content external support dependence
subjects.settles: Determine how active-content performance changes when specified external support is available or removed.
subjects.excludes: Assuming every working-memory task must exclude all external support.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Memory active content persistence duration
subjects.settles: Determine how long specified active content remains usable under stated interference and support conditions.
subjects.excludes: A fixed universal lifetime or proof that time alone causes loss.
subjects.source: Authored precise subject from the current perspective investigation.

subjects.name: Reasoning approach specification completeness
subjects.settles: Determine whether an approach specification resolves every execution-relevant choice required by its declared contract, including explicit permitted discretion.
subjects.excludes: Requiring deterministic choice for every generative method or proving effectiveness from textual completeness.
subjects.source: Derived from actual source-rule gaps and the study/system relationship cases.

subjects.name: Reasoning approach branch coverage
subjects.settles: Determine whether every admitted input or reachable state has a defined continuation or terminal outcome under the approach's rules.
subjects.excludes: Correctness of the continuation, coverage outside the declared domain, or counting branch labels alone.
subjects.source: Derived from actual source-rule gaps and the study/system relationship cases.

subjects.name: Reasoning approach rule consistency
subjects.settles: Determine whether simultaneously applicable rules can be jointly satisfied under the approach's declared precedence and scope.
subjects.excludes: Whether the compatible rules are desirable or empirically effective.
subjects.source: Derived from actual source-rule gaps and the study/system relationship cases.

subjects.name: Inquiry finding transfer condition
subjects.settles: Determine which assumptions and case qualifications must hold for an existing finding to justify a stated conclusion in a new inquiry.
subjects.excludes: Reusing a method without transferring its prior conclusion or copying a result without its premises.
subjects.source: Derived from actual source-rule gaps and the study/system relationship cases.

subjects.name: Inquiry finding use contribution
subjects.settles: Determine how using a specified earlier finding changes the work or result of a later inquiry with its target and standard fixed.
subjects.excludes: Truth of the reused finding alone, method transfer alone or a merely added citation.
subjects.source: Derived from actual source-rule gaps and the study/system relationship cases.

subjects.name: System composition order dependence
subjects.settles: Determine which changes of component execution order change a specified system result when the components and input are fixed.
subjects.excludes: Differences caused by adding components, changing their implementations or changing the input.
subjects.source: Derived from actual source-rule gaps and the study/system relationship cases.

subjects.name: System composition description sufficiency
subjects.settles: Determine whether a specified description fixes the system properties needed for an identified task, or whether two realizations satisfy it while differing on those properties.
subjects.excludes: Assuming a set of topics specifies causal order, interfaces or stopping behavior.
subjects.source: Derived from actual source-rule gaps and the study/system relationship cases.

subjects.name: Perspective bearer attribution
subjects.settles: Determine which specified entity, component or interaction bears the configuration responsible for a declared response distinction.
subjects.excludes: Assigning consciousness, goals or all downstream effects to the named component.
subjects.source: User clarification and current perspective development, 7 September 2026.

subjects.name: Perspective response sensitivity
subjects.settles: Determine which specified input or context changes alter an identified bearer response under declared comparison conditions.
subjects.excludes: The bearer consciously noticing the difference or its response being beneficial.
subjects.source: User clarification and current perspective development, 7 September 2026.

subjects.name: Perspective response equivalence
subjects.settles: Determine whether two response configurations yield the same specified observable response on every case of a declared domain.
subjects.excludes: Identity of mechanisms, experience, cost or behavior outside the domain.
subjects.source: User clarification and current perspective development, 7 September 2026.

subjects.name: Perspective change locus
subjects.settles: Determine which specified part of a bearer-context arrangement changed between two response episodes.
subjects.excludes: Attributing improvement, causal sufficiency or intentional revision from the changed result alone.
subjects.source: User clarification and current perspective development, 7 September 2026.

subjects.name: Perspective problem recognition contribution
subjects.settles: Determine how changing a perspective changes which problems are recognized in a fixed presented situation under a fixed relevance standard.
subjects.excludes: The choice to act on a recognized problem or a difference caused solely by new presented evidence.
subjects.source: User clarification and current perspective development, 7 September 2026.

subjects.name: Perspective subject relevance determination
subjects.settles: Determine what result from a specified subject would contribute to the current matter under an identified perspective and conditions.
subjects.excludes: Technique selection, truth of the result or relevance inferred only from topic similarity.
subjects.source: User clarification and current perspective development, 7 September 2026.

subjects.name: Perspective study configuration construction
subjects.settles: Construct a system arrangement of specified studies whose results supply identified subsequent contributions under an adopted perspective.
subjects.excludes: An unordered subject list, automatic truth of outputs or proof of overall effectiveness.
subjects.source: User clarification and current perspective development, 7 September 2026.

subjects.name: Perspective result interpretation rule
subjects.settles: Specify how materially different results of an identified study change a perspective, its commitment or its next contribution.
subjects.excludes: Producing the study result or establishing the interpretation rule's truth.
subjects.source: User clarification and current perspective development, 7 September 2026.

subjects.name: Perspective transition construction
subjects.settles: Construct an operation intended to make a specified change of perspective available from declared starting conditions.
subjects.excludes: Merely naming the destination or assuming the operation necessarily succeeds.
subjects.source: User clarification and current perspective development, 7 September 2026.

subjects.name: Perspective transition applicability
subjects.settles: Determine whether the declared requirements of a specified perspective-transition operation hold in identified starting conditions.
subjects.excludes: Actual transition success, retention or suitability of the destination.
subjects.source: User clarification and current perspective development, 7 September 2026.

subjects.name: Perspective transition reachability
subjects.settles: Determine which specified perspectives can be reached through identified transition operations under declared starting conditions and path constraints.
subjects.excludes: Reachability through unknown operations, successful real execution or a universally optimal route.
subjects.source: User clarification and current perspective development, 7 September 2026.

subjects.name: Perspective improvement retention
subjects.settles: Determine whether a previously established beneficial perspective change remains available for relevant use after a specified interval or transition.
subjects.excludes: Establishing the original benefit, immediate repetition alone or assuming a saved note is used.
subjects.source: User clarification and current perspective development, 7 September 2026.

subjects.name: Perspective formation condition
subjects.settles: Determine which specified conditions make a perspective newly available to an identified bearer or arrangement.
subjects.excludes: Later activation of an available perspective or universal necessity of one origin.
subjects.source: User clarification and current perspective development, 7 September 2026.

subjects.name: Perspective activation trigger
subjects.settles: Identify which event or condition brings an available perspective into operative use in a declared context.
subjects.excludes: Its construction, conscious choice or suitability for the context.
subjects.source: User clarification and current perspective development, 7 September 2026.

subjects.name: Perspective adoption commitment
subjects.settles: Specify the scope and degree of reliance assigned to an interpretation in a particular inquiry or action.
subjects.excludes: Evidence-warranted confidence or commitment attributed to every physical bearer.
subjects.source: User clarification and current perspective development, 7 September 2026.

subjects.name: Perspective adoption correspondence
subjects.settles: Determine whether observed distinctions and operations correspond to an agent's declared perspective in an identified context.
subjects.excludes: A diagnosis, a hidden true self, complete introspective access or truth of the declared account.
subjects.source: User clarification and current perspective development, 7 September 2026.

subjects.name: Perspective candidate dimension construction
subjects.settles: Construct a consequential distinction for organizing perspectives absent from the stated initial construction scheme.
subjects.excludes: Renaming an existing dimension or adding a label without a separating case.
subjects.source: User clarification and current perspective development, 7 September 2026.

subjects.name: Perspective candidate space specification
subjects.settles: Specify the perspectives constructible from declared dimensions, values and compatibility rules under a fixed identity convention.
subjects.excludes: All possible perspectives being captured or every combination being semantically adequate.
subjects.source: User clarification and current perspective development, 7 September 2026.

subjects.name: Perspective candidate space coverage
subjects.settles: Determine whether a specified perspective inventory supplies required distinctions or contributions across every case of a declared domain.
subjects.excludes: Universal perspective completeness or coverage by one individual perspective.
subjects.source: User clarification and current perspective development, 7 September 2026.

subjects.name: Perspective exploration exclusion justification
subjects.settles: Determine whether an identified reason justifies excluding a candidate perspective from a specified exploration purpose and stage.
subjects.excludes: Permanent rejection, falsity of every candidate claim or final perspective selection.
subjects.source: User clarification and current perspective development, 7 September 2026.

subjects.name: Perspective composition interference
subjects.settles: Determine how combining perspectives impairs an identified contribution relative to their separately specified uses.
subjects.excludes: Mere component count, independent component failure or automatic incompatibility of different viewpoints.
subjects.source: User clarification and current perspective development, 7 September 2026.

subjects.name: Perspective improvement transfer
subjects.settles: Determine which conditions permit a previously established beneficial perspective change to contribute in a new setting.
subjects.excludes: Shared wording, retention only in the original setting or benefit in every related case.
subjects.source: User clarification and current perspective development, 7 September 2026.
